# Bare to Bold Nail Studio

> Russian manicure & nail art studio based in Round Rock, Texas. Kimmy's private studio on Chisholm Trail Rd in Round Rock: a detailed e-file dry manicure, builder gel that helps natural nails grow stronger, and custom art from a quiet nude to a full statement set.

## Services
- Russian manicure + builder gel: A detailed e-file dry manicure with precise cuticle work, shaping, and a strengthening builder gel overlay on your natural nails, finished in one solid color.
- Gel-X extensions: Length from short to medium with the Aprés Gel-X soft gel system, refined and balanced to suit your natural nail, after the same careful Russian prep.
- Nail art: From a fine line or a French tip to chrome, cat eye, 3D flowers and full character sets. Send your inspiration photos and Kimmy matches the right art tier.

## About
Bare to Bold is Kimmy's studio. One artist, one chair, and appointments spaced so every set gets her full attention, from the first pass of the e-file to the last coat of top gel. Before each client: every surface cleaned, every tool prepared, every detail reset. The work is built on the Russian manicure: a dry e-file manicure with no soaking, careful cuticle work and a builder gel overlay that protects your natural nails while they grow. Clients who want length get Aprés Gel-X soft gel extensions. Acrylic, plastic tips and dip powder are not offered, and if you come in with over-filed or damaged nails from somewhere else, Kimmy removes the old product gently and works on getting them healthy again. Then it can go anywhere. Short milky nudes and clean French tips, cherry red almonds, chrome and cat eye, or hand-painted and 3D art. Elegance doesn't need to be loud, but it can be when you want it to. Clients describe the result as clean, precise and long-lasting, and some drive more than an hour and a half to keep coming back.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What is a Russian manicure?
  A: It's a detailed dry manicure done with an electric file instead of soaking in water. The cuticle area is cleaned very precisely, so the color can sit close to the skin and grow out neatly. At Bare to Bold it is the first step of every manicure and extension service.
- Q: Do you do acrylic or dip powder?
  A: No. Acrylic, plastic tips and dip powder are not offered. Kimmy works with builder gel on natural nails and Aprés Gel-X soft gel extensions for length.
- Q: I have product on from another salon. What do I book?
  A: Book the Foreign Product Removal version of the builder gel or Gel-X service. Kimmy safely removes the old acrylic, dip, gel or Gel-X before starting your new set, which can take a little extra time.
- Q: How do I choose a nail art tier?
  A: Nail art comes in four tiers, from minimal details to complex custom art. DM or text your inspiration photos before you book so the right tier is selected for your design.
- Q: Is there a deposit?
  A: Yes, a 20 dollar deposit secures your appointment and goes toward your total. You can reschedule once with at least 24 hours' notice to keep it. Cancellations under 24 hours lose the deposit.
- Q: How long does an appointment take?
  A: Plan on about two to two and a half hours for a manicure or extension service, plus extra time for detailed nail art.
- Q: Are you open over the holidays?
  A: Kimmy is visiting Vietnam from November 30 and back at the studio December 20. If you want your nails done before then, book ahead to get your preferred spot.
